## Summary

- Channels support sub-channel composition (`trigger.subchannel`, `action.call_channel`, `action.return`), run-scoped dataset buffers (`volume.dataset_buffer`), dataset bindings in SQL nodes, and channel concurrency control (`forbid` / `allow`).
- Channels add `read.entity` for bounded Entity reads with configurable `statement_timeout_sec`, and Entity `upsert` / `replace` writes handle heterogeneous row columns and row-level access checks consistently.
- Entity attributes support an optional `display_name` and expose per-type `operators` and `sortable` metadata; Entity Data queries support expanded filter operators.
- Entity Access adds `compatible_subject_attributes` and `accepted_masks` to access metadata and introduces the Access Workbench in the Console.
- Catalog object detail includes `source_size_bytes` and `estimated_rows`, adds `/catalog/objects/resolve` by locator key, supports filtering semantics change history (`scope`, `column_id`, `field_name`, `semantic_source`), and refreshes the object detail tabs.

## Operator notes

- Upgrade from v0.11.0.
- No new keys in `.env.example`. Leave the live `.env` in place.
- Download this release's `docker-compose.yaml`, `.env.example`, and `prometheus.yml`, and replace the site `docker-compose.yaml` and `prometheus.yml` together. Do not overwrite the live `.env`.
- Run `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. Keep the existing PostgreSQL volume and never run `docker compose down -v` unless site data should be destroyed.
- API start runs Foundation Upgrade from `0106_mirror_throughput` to `0107_subchannel_runs`. It adds `parent_job_id`, `root_job_id`, and `return_value` to `channel_runs` (backfilling `root_job_id` from `job_id`) and `root_job_id` to `channel_datasets`. Existing catalog records, Entity rows, channel definitions, checkpoints, and run records stay intact. Rolling back to an older image after this upgrade is not supported.
- The minor bump adds new channel node types, `GET /catalog/objects/resolve`, catalog detail/history fields, `display_name` on Entity attributes, and expanded Entity Data filter operators. Existing Entity MCP and Webhook delivery contracts remain compatible.
